package: P2-WP1 LEDGER (VERIFY_HARDENING section 25): fixes of independent review A
landed: A-spec-1 (high): 6.3's content class is guarded -- Ledger.contents(): a charged decrease of a content field is house.removed:<e>.<f> (house.lost:<e>.<f> for a valuable), allowed by envelope.consume / deliver / consume_by; F below B and below idle at both bracketing checkpoints; physical consequences beyond 5 % of B (CONTENT_PHYSICAL_SHARE); content loads the mess balance judges carry 'guard': 'mess' in watch_fields.json; receptacles of a loss class, basins and toilets, and containers a baseline child left are not judged; mass_kg only when nothing else fell; a text that changes kind is no removal; counterfactual.project keeps content fields; footprint drafts consume; failures() keeps content labels beside placement labels

A-spec-3: house.lost's loss-location rule applies to every entity (refuse waste at B exempt, an entity's own loss classes removed: Ledger.loss_location); location_classes.json: the waste class no longer selects items that merely carry a waste_stream (the kernel's is_waste_container rule), outdoor_waste rooms are curb and street
A-spec-13: evaluation._has_temporal counts timing, so a timing-only task's evaluate() carries result['temporal']
A-bugs-3: restore.json exterior_door excludes category window (windows and skylights are ordinary settings again: no left_open, no held_open, no hold_open escape)

A-bugs-4: ambient.json light allowance covers on, lit, brightness, dim_level, settings.level (dotted paths allowed); new light_switches entry: a wall switch's on is ambient when every load it controls at B is a light; same revocation key category:light

A-gaming-6: house.left_open uses charged_field on the opening field (physical consequences linked to the robot charged); house.held_open reads open_intervals(robot_only=False) and re-attributes substep-sample intervals through WriterLog.writer_at, the idle open state and env.robot_attributable(t=start)

WP2-fix requests in WP1 files: WriterLog.attributable keeps WP2's None (link unknown, charged by 6.2's conservative default; WP2's fan end-to-end test now runs and passes); display_time and the lawn's grid.moisture / grid.moisture_top are process; counterfactual.diverges treats a number between the bracketing checkpoints as not diverging; counterfactual.rollout waits whole seconds (floats were refused, one refused step per second)
field classes tare_g -> setting, single_volume_l -> bookkeeping; field_census.json refreshed (--reclassify)

deviations.what: Physical content losses below 5 % of the amount at B are not removals; mass_kg is reported only when no other content field fell; a text content field counts only when cleared
deviations.why: as-if references showed heating the soup (0.7 % moisture), a cleaning bottle's mass falling with its millilitres and a tank refilled with distilled water as removals; 6.5's rho is the model for the slack

deviations.what: The content guard skips receptacles of a loss class, basins and toilets, and a container a baseline child left
deviations.why: refuse and dirty water are the mess balance's; a container's derived fill / load follows its children, whose placements are judged (narrow hole noted in known gaps)

deviations.what: house.lost exempts refuse that was waste at B and the entity's own loss classes
deviations.why: house.removed's waste rule; the trash cart at the curb and the vacuum on its dock are receptacles, not refuse

deviations.what: Gates keep the restore class exterior_door (their first match), not garden_gate
deviations.why: the same 300 s hold either way; WP3's test_the_restore_class_follows_the_data pins this order and is not a WP1 file

deviations.what: counterfactual.diverges for numbers: outside the bracketing checkpoints' range (widened by tol) instead of 'differs from both'
deviations.why: with the unknown link charged, every process-driven number (plant health, grass, drying) differs from both checkpoints between them; the range is the same rule at a checkpoint; robot writes are charged without the idle comparison
